metadata.initialization: deterministic RS plus .02 total hierarchy spread; break RS at every collapsed continuation point
metadata.reference: Mike Winer and Boris Hanin, Deep Neural Nets as Hamiltonians, arXiv:2503.23982v2, Appendix A.2; Fig. 2; https://arxiv.org/html/2503.23982v2
metadata.model: Gaussian x~N(0,I_d); H=sum_i a_i sin(w_i.x); w_ij~N(0,1/d), a_i~N(0,1); N/d=1
metadata.method: minimize finite-step off-diagonal Parisi profile at fixed diagonal, maximize over diagonal
metadata.thermodynamic_limit: d,N→∞ with N/d=1; finite 20-step replica ansatz, not a finite-network simulation
